parsed.explanation: The combined operative regime links Article 629 criminalisation, absence of legal-sex alignment, state hospitality crackdowns, warrantless police searches, detention abuse, birth-sex prison placement, and incited violence. For an outed adult visitor, the credible trajectory moves from document/appearance mismatch to extortion, reporting, police contact, custody, and possible abuse; a minor/guardian pair has no documented protection. Capital-based events are documented; elsewhere remains unknown and silence is not safety. No credible execution pathway is shown, so the score sits above extreme anchors, but state-tolerated custody harm and organised targeting dominate.

entry_documents.exposure: No legal-sex marker pathway; trans men legally women and trans women legally men. A documented passport male-marker trans woman was extorted and reported to authorities. Visitor border screening not documented.
entry_documents.protection: No acceptance of mismatched/self-identified markers or documented border respect protocols is recorded.
entry_documents.interaction: Passport/presentation mismatch can convert hospitality, reporting or extortion into police contact; criminal law supplies pretext if relationship reads same-sex.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Warrantless residential searches, detention abuse, 2014 inmate assault, and a year-long men's-prison placement of a trans person with staff and inmate sexual/physical abuse.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: No freedom from arbitrary arrest, complaint protection, counsel access, or safe placement documented.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Detention follows document/appearance mismatch, venue raids, or neighbour/family complaints; prison placement by legal sex increases severity.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Capital hospitality venues were raided for suspected same-sex acts and officials urged public reporting; healthcare/service discrimination nationwide. Ward placement not documented.
federal_state_facilities.protection: No anti-discrimination shelter, facility, or accommodation protection; no documented lodging respect for markers.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Hotel/guesthouse checks or venue presence can trigger police referral; subnational data only capital.

care_services.exposure: Societal healthcare discrimination is documented, including stigma and exclusion; no emergency-care respect protocol for mismatched markers.
care_services.protection: No gender-identity health protection, advocate office, or complaint mechanism documented.
care_services.interaction: Care seeking can out travellers through records, staff bias, or partner/relationship assumptions; HIV-related stigma worsens concealment.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Article 629 criminalises same-sex conduct; 2023 security crackdowns, municipal reporting calls, surveillance/entrapment, online incitement to stabbing and killing, physical attacks.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: No GI hate-crime/hate-speech law, no protection from arbitrary arrest, no registered advocacy or lawful events.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Criminalisation and no LGR frame trans presentation as suspected same-sex conduct; state/municipal action legitimises private violence.

minors_guardians.exposure: No visitor minor rule documented; family outing risk is inferred from police disclosing orientation to relatives and stigma in youth services.
minors_guardians.protection: No documented guardian protection, age-appropriate care, or anti-discrimination shelter for travelling families.
minors_guardians.interaction: Venue raids, lodging checks, or healthcare can escalate adult risk into family disclosure or pressure on guardians.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Non-state online incitement ended in physical attacks; police residential searches, abuse during detention, and outing to families are reported.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Police provide no documented victim protection; no hate-crime response or accountability for detention abuse.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Reports, surveillance, and hospitality raids move street/hostility harms into state custody; capital-only evidence leaves other areas unknown.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No registration, workplace/housing protection, hate-crime remedy, or reliable trial records; penalties inconsistent; post-2023 prosecutions and non-capital practice unknown.
remedies_unknowns.protection: No effective legal aid, oversight, or traveller complaint pathway is documented.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Absence of remedy makes state custody and social attacks more likely to escalate; uncertainty is not safety.

anchor_checks.comparison: 0.15-A: similar in illusory recourse and custody abuse, but slightly safer because no capital punishment or routine visitor arrest for presentation is documented.
0.25-C: here sits lower because men's-prison sexual/physical abuse involved staff/inmates alongside organised municipal raids and violent incitement; 0.25-C lacks comparable state-tolerated harm.
0.35-B: this is more severe; 0.35-B stops, confiscates, fines and releases without credible imprisonment, while this dossier documents long birth-sex custody, abuse and physical attacks.

parsed.synthesis: Documented interactions across law, documents and institutions produce one severe risk system: criminalisation supplies pretext; legal-sex mismatch invites extortion and reporting; state detention/prison placement exposes people to abuse; 2023 municipal raids and online incitement increase outing and physical attack probability. Lack of anti-discrimination and hate-crime remedies removes practical recourse. Capital evidence is specific; non-capital and post-2023 enforcement are uncertain, not safe. Adult-alone travellers face severe risk; minors face unverified but higher family/venue/care exposure.
